description: One Totem can be equipped per team. Its effects apply to all 5 heroes in battle.

totems.name: Primordial Everbloom
totems.summary: Energy-cycle totem with teamwide tempo buffs, healing, and energy refund.

effects.description: For every 3500 Energy consumed, allies enter an 8s active state, boosting their ATK, ATK SPD, and Energy Regen by 10% and reducing skill CD by 10%.
For every 1200 Energy consumed by allies, the most vulnerable ally receives healing equal to 10% of max HP.
For every 3500 Energy consumed, allies enter an 8s active state, boosting their ATK, ATK SPD, and Energy Regen by 20% and reducing skill CD by 20%.
For every 1200 Energy consumed by allies, all allies restore 40 Energy.

totems.name: All-Seeing Eyes
totems.summary: Snowball totem that rewards the first early kill with burst damage and energy.

effects.description: Within the first 10s of battle, the first ally who kills an enemy restores 100 Energy and deals 15% increased DMG.
Increases the unit's DMG dealt by 30%.
Restores an additional 200 Energy.
Effect can trigger again after killing a target and is stackable.

totems.name: Branch of Serenity
totems.summary: Simple full-team Armor and M-RES boost for safer, steadier fights.

effects.description: At combat start, increases all allies' Armor and M-RES by 20% for the entire battle.
Armor and M-RES +25%.
Armor and M-RES +30%.
Armor and M-RES +35%.

totems.name: Defiant Vow
totems.summary: Defensive anti-focus totem that scales when allies are pressured by enemy targeting.

effects.description: For each ally targeted by an enemy, gains 20% Armor and M-RES, stacking up to 6 times.
Gains 25% Armor and M-RES.
Gains 30% Armor and M-RES.
Gains 15% Lifesteal when targeted by 3 or more units.

totems.name: Eternal Eclipse
totems.summary: Periodic AoE strike that scales from your highest ATK ally and amplifies follow-up damage.

effects.description: At the 5th second after entering battle and every 15s thereafter, deals DMG equal to 260% of the highest ATK among allies to clustered enemies.
Deals 360% ATK as DMG.
Also increases DMG taken by hit targets by 20%.
Increases the range to 5 meters and knocks down units hit.

totems.name: Horn of Potency
totems.summary: Straightforward teamwide ATK boost with no setup required.

effects.description: At combat start, increases all allies' ATK by 6%.
ATK +8%.

totems.name: Keystone of Wonders
totems.summary: Multi-suit scaling totem that boosts damage, durability, and later max HP.

effects.description: Each suit owned increases allies' DMG dealt by 4% and reduces DMG taken by 4%.
Each suit owned increases DMG dealt by 6% and reduces DMG taken by 6%.
Increases max HP by 8% per suit.
Each suit owned increases allies' DMG dealt by 8% and reduces DMG taken by 8%.

totems.name: Moonglow Tear
totems.summary: Opening control totem that adds immediate burst and crowd control at battle start.

effects.description: At combat start, highest HP ally deals 250% of team average ATK as DMG and roots enemies for 3s.
Deals 350% ATK as DMG.
Also inflicts a 3s stun.
Deals 450% ATK as DMG.

totems.name: Sanctified Blood
totems.summary: Periodic sustain totem that heals weakened allies throughout longer fights.

effects.description: Every 15s starting at 5s, restores 20% max HP to lowest HP ally.
Triggers every 12s.
Affects one additional ally.
Restores 30% of max HP to the lowest HP ally.

totems.name: Sigil of Longevity
totems.summary: Basic max HP booster for extra frontline and team durability.

effects.description: At combat start, increases max HP by 10%.
Max HP +12.5%.
Max HP +15%.
Max HP +17.5%.

totems.name: Solar Scorch
totems.summary: Periodic long-range burst totem that strikes the farthest enemy with knockdown pressure.

effects.description: Every 20s starting at 5s, deals 200% of highest ATK to farthest enemy.
Also knocks down the target.
Deals 300% ATK of the highest ATK among allies.
Affects one more unit.

totems.name: Undying Staff
totems.summary: Emergency survival totem that prevents an early collapse with invincibility and shielding.

effects.description: When first ally is about to fall, becomes invincible for 1.5s (once per battle).
Grants shield equal to 500% of ATK.
Invincibility lasts 3s.
Triggers one extra time.

totems.name: Unsullied Lotus
totems.summary: Aggressive positioning totem that rewards pushing into the enemy half with buffs and sustain.

effects.description: First time entering enemy half, gains shield equal to 30% max HP.
Allies gain 20% ATK and ATK SPD in enemy half.
Restore 15% HP every 5s while in enemy half.
After allies stay in the enemy half for 15s (counted individually per unit), enters the (Ascension) state, increasing max HP by 40% and DMG dealt by 20%.

totems.name: Windrunner's Grace
totems.summary: Carry-support totem that empowers your highest ATK ally with speed, ATK, and energy.

effects.description: Grants highest ATK ally 50% ATK SPD for 10s.
Gains 25% ATK.
Restores 20 Energy per second.
Gains Super Armor for the duration.
